subject.why: The ruby gemstone is immediately recognisable, nicely faceted, and features the requested sparkle on the top facet.

category.why: The gem floats tilted in the air with no ground plane, set against a vibrant radiating sunburst pattern.

clean.why: There are no UI elements, borders, watermarks, text, or characters.

framing.why: The gem is centered with ample, balanced breathing room on all sides.

colour.why: Vibrant saturated red gemstone pops cleanly against the warm lime-green background.

detail.why: No noisy micro-textures, scratches, or unnecessary extra props are present.

style.why: Smooth, chunky 3D volumes with soft bevels and a clean satin sheen, fully consistent with the reference style.
